method: every non-comment call of checkSharedRateLimit / checkAuthRateLimit / checkRateLimit under src/ is parsed (arguments, key template, threshold and window expressions, resolved through their declarations); calls routed through a wrapper function are expanded at the wrapper's callers; each fact cites path, line and an anchor on that line, and the cited files are frozen under source/awcms-impl/. Threshold defaults are the values in source, not the values in any .env file.

limiter.statement: fixed-window counter: the first hit opens a window, later hits in it increment, and the request is refused once the count exceeds maxAttempts
checkRateLimit counts in a per-process Map keyed by the bucket key
checkSharedRateLimit counts in Redis (INCR, PEXPIRE on first use) when a Redis client is configured; the window index is part of the Redis key
without Redis, checkSharedRateLimit delegates to the in-process checkRateLimit
when Redis is configured but a command fails, the shared limiter allows the request
hard cap on live in-process buckets; soonest-to-expire buckets are evicted beyond it
interval between sweeps of elapsed buckets
a refusal carries retryAfterSec = ceil(remaining window / 1000), minimum 1
X-Forwarded-For is honoured only when TRUSTED_PROXY_ENABLED is exactly "true"; otherwise the socket address is the client
with trust enabled the client is the X-Forwarded-For entry TRUSTED_PROXY_HOP_COUNT positions from the right (default shown)
parsePositiveIntSetting rejects non-finite, non-integer and non-positive values and returns the default

auth_limiter.statement: checks the shared per-source bucket first, then the per-route bucket keyed by client IP, the caller-supplied tenant id and the scope; the first refusal is returned

claims.claim: per-IP rate limits alone could not prevent repeated email delivery to a victim address; recipient-oriented cooldown semantics were required
claims.finding: POST /api/v1/newsletter/subscribe is limited per client IP only, and a separate per-recipient cooldown is enforced inside the upsert statement: a confirmation e-mail is re-issued to an existing (tenant_id, email_normalized) row only when its confirmation_sent_at is NULL or older than the cooldown. The cooldown is a predicate of the ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE branch, so a refused re-send returns the same neutral response as every other branch.
